meta.title: WoW Forever — all profession recipes, reagents and sources / Все рецепты профессий, реагенты и источники
meta.source: Wowhead (www.wowhead.com/forever), RU names from Wowhead RU locale
meta.skillColors: orange=required skill (always skill-up), yellow, green, grey = skill at which the recipe changes colour
meta.foreverField: new = added in Forever, updated = changed vs vanilla, unchanged = vanilla

sourceTypes.auto: learned automatically with profession rank (Seemeta, game files)
sourceTypes.recipe_item: taught by a recipe item (Seemeta); exact source unknown

caveats: Drops list = top 8 NPCs by drop chance; worldDrop=true when 15+ different mobs drop it.
learn.probablyUnavailable=true marks 31 spells that exist in data but have no source anywhere (SoD leftovers etc.); an addon should hide them by default.
Vendor lists: complete for each recipe item from Wowhead.

About 230 recipe items (mostly new Forever ones) have no source on Wowhead yet (checked item pages: empty). For them learn.seemeta gives the recipe-item skill and reputation requirement when known; exact vendor/drop is unknown until Wowhead data-mines it. An in-game merchant/loot scanner in the addon can fill these.
readme_for_claude: Top-level keys: professions (by slug), reagents (by itemId), npcs (by npcId: en, ru, zones[], react, level), zones (by zoneId: en, ru), quests (by questId).

Each recipe: spellId, name_en/name_ru, skill {required, orange, yellow, green, grey}, creates {itemId,en,ru,min,max}, reagents [{itemId,en,ru,count}], learn {types[], trainerCostCopper?, sourceDetails?, recipeItems[]}.

recipeItems[]: item {id,name_en,name_ru,requiredSkill}, types[], vendors[{npc,costCopper,stock(-1 = unlimited)}], drops[{npc,chancePct}], worldDrop, quests[questId], sourceDetails[{type,id,name_en,name_ru,zone}], note.
Resolve npc/zone/quest ids through the npcs/zones/quests dictionaries. All ids are game ids usable in the WoW API (GetItemInfo, C_TradeSkillUI etc.) and on wowhead.com/forever.
Recipes with learn.types=["trainer"] are taught by profession trainers; trainerCostCopper is the training price.
learn.seemeta (from seemeta.com, datamined game files): text, autoLearned, trainer, recipeItemId, recipeItemSkill, reputation {standing, faction}. Use it when Wowhead fields are empty.
